title: Our approach to Agentic AI
key_claim: Firms and their senior managers stay responsible for agents they deploy or buy in; a business calling itself a technology provider may still need authorisation for payments, financial promotions, credit broking or advice, and the FCA can intervene against unauthorised regulated services.
frame_summary: Argues that existing principles-based rules already reach agentic AI, so the authorisation line is drawn by what an agent does, not by how its provider describes itself.
verbatim_quote: Just because a business describes itself as a technology provider does not mean that they do not need to be authorised
verbatim_list: We have powers to intervene if we believe regulated financial services are being offered without our authorisation

title: Building the future of finance in the age of AI (speech by Jessica Rusu)
key_claim: The FCA will build a trusted framework for agentic finance covering agent identity, delegated authority, accountability and execution, and aims to make the existing boundary clearer rather than expand its remit; only 40% of consumers recognise there is no recourse if something goes wrong.
frame_summary: Argues that agents able to move money raise the stakes, and that the answer is a clearer existing perimeter plus an industry-built trust framework rather than a wider FCA remit.
verbatim_quote: Our answer is not simply to expand our remit, but to make the existing boundary clearer.
verbatim_list: but only 40% of consumers correctly recognise that there is no recourse if something goes wrong

title: Artificial intelligence in UK financial services - 2026
key_claim: 86% of 196 surveyed firms use AI; 80% have agents deployed for decision support, only 2% with broad autonomy, and no more than 9% expect agents to initiate, execute or block payments.
frame_summary: Describes regulated firms adopting agents widely but keeping them on a short leash, with almost no planned use of agents to move money.

title: UK banks reportedly block AI agents from accessing customer accounts
